ModMetadata.Name: Sonic Ether Global Illumination [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: vinus
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Sonic Ether Global Illumination[/h1] [b]WARNING:[/b] This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires Bepinex to be installed with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
**Full credits to Erdoy for the original port to Stationeers.Addons!!!** A fully-dynamic voxel-based global illumination system for Stationeers. This is a port of Stationeers.SEGI for Stationeers.Mods. https://github.com/Erdroy/Stationeers.SEGI/ https://github.com/sonicether/SEGI
you can also go here to get the dll itself if you want to just put it in your bepinex/plugins folder: https://github.com/TerameTechYT/StationeersSharp/
